role: operational authorized raw-data materialization only; no scientific model fitting
download_scope: all GPS events within each full calendar year; no spring-only truncation at raw-materialization stage
rationale: movepp phase classification requires unbiased annual context; seasonal restriction occurs only in frozen downstream preprocessing

authentication.method: MOVEBANK_API_TOKEN environment variable in a protected local execution environment

license.required_user_state: authorized account must have accepted any required terms in Movebank before local materialization
license.terms_page_behavior: fail closed and write BLOCKED manifest

raw_data_governance.storage: authorized protected local directory outside the Git repository only

execution_boundary: successful materialization opens raw movement events but does not open the preregistered cue-uptake coefficient or threshold result
next_gate: After authorized local materialization, preserve raw files privately and copy only the nonraw manifest/receipt into the project. Run frozen movepp preprocessing only after exact/source-backed route geometry is materialized.

execution_environment.github_actions: unit tests and safeguard validation only; never download or upload focal raw GPS events
execution_environment.reason: study-specific Movebank terms may restrict redistribution and GitHub artifacts are not treated as an approved raw-data repository
